title: Map untrusted virtual paths inside a filesystem sandbox
instruction: Harden SandboxPathMapper without changing its API. Resolve and store root as an existing directory at construction. virtual_path must be a non-empty string representing a relative virtual path; treat both slash and backslash as separators on every platform, reject NUL, empty segments, dot/parent segments, drive-prefixed paths, UNC forms, and absolute paths. The returned native Path must remain inside the resolved root even when any existing ancestor is a symlink. For a non-existing leaf, resolve the deepest existing ancestor and append only validated remaining segments. must_exist must be an exact bool; when true require the final target to exist, otherwise raise FileNotFoundError. Never create filesystem entries and never mutate inputs. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-3 containment lineage covering platform-independent separators, symlink ancestors, and non-existing leaves.
